description: Creates all tables, indexes and the schema_meta bookkeeping row if absent. Idempotent: safe to call on every process start.
docstring:
Create the full schema (schema_meta, runs, run_events, raw_games, games_enriched, game_tags, analysis_results and all indexes from 01_storage.module_spec.json) if it does not already exist.

Args:
    conn: An open connection from get_connection.

Returns:
    None.

Raises:
    StorageError: If table creation fails for a reason other than 'already exists' (e.g. a conflicting, incompatible table already present under the same name with a different shape).
preconditions: conn was opened by get_connection (pragmas already applied)
postconditions: All seven tables and five indexes listed in the module spec's schema.tables / schema.indexes exist
schema_meta contains exactly one row with version == current_schema_version(conn) after a fresh initialization
Calling initialize_schema twice in a row is a no-op the second time and does not raise

edge_cases.input: Called on a brand-new, empty database file
edge_cases.expected_behavior: creates everything and inserts the initial schema_meta row

edge_cases.input: Called on a database that already has the current schema
edge_cases.expected_behavior: no-op, returns None, does not duplicate schema_meta rows

edge_cases.input: Called on a database with a table of the same name but an incompatible column set (corrupted/foreign file)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: StorageError, does not silently drop or alter the existing table

unit_tests.name: test_creates_all_tables_and_indexes
unit_tests.description: Against a fresh in-memory database, all seven tables and five indexes appear in sqlite_master.
unit_tests.expected: seven table names and five index names present

unit_tests.name: test_idempotent_second_call
unit_tests.description: Calling twice does not raise and leaves exactly one schema_meta row.

unit_tests.name: test_conflicting_table_raises
unit_tests.description: A pre-existing incompatible 'runs' table raises StorageError.
